steps.content: The next day, at the abandoned factory on the outskirts of the city.
According to Eureka, this is where she used to work. The once grand factory buildings now stand as nothing more than ruins, with faint traces of explosions visible on the remains of the structures.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: There used to be a group of stray cats here. I wonder if the kittens have all grown up by now? I have no idea where they ended up... Huh? The automatic stirring feeding bowl I left at their den is still here? That was the first invention I made when I was a child...

Eureka mumbles to herself as she walks into the factory, her voice growing fainter and fainter. The desolate scene before her eyes takes her back to her past. The memory fragments are harrowing, but tell the story of her entire childhood.

steps.speaker: Classmate
steps.content: What is this? Have you been dumpster diving? Isn't this the can I just threw away? Did you steal anything else, oh great inventor? Hahahaha!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: No, I didn't steal anything... It's not useless! It's an automatic stirring feeding bowl I made for the stray cats at school... It's still not quite stable, but I made it all by myself... It's my hard work...

steps.speaker: Teacher
steps.content: Eureka, your grades have dropped a lot. They were already low, and now they've fallen even lower. Do you think you can get into university like this? How are you going to make your parents proud?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: We scrimp and save to pay for your education, and this is how you repay us?! With these terrible grades?!

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: Eureka, stop wasting time on those useless things. Can't you make us happy for once? Why are you always so naughty?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Look at this <color=#fb9259>garbage</color> you're wasting your time on! You should be studying hard to become a rich financier, not burying your head in this <color=#fb9259>junk</color> all day!

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: Mommy threw away all your <color=#fb9259>garbage</color> for you. I put a stack of new exercise books in their place. You must complete them before the end of the term.

steps.speaker: Teacher
steps.content: I will give all the <color=#fb9259>garbage</color> you made in class to your parents. Go and tell them to come meet me.

steps.speaker: Classmate
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Freak! Weirdo! Garbage girl! No one likes you! Go to hell!</color>

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Sorry, I started talking to myself again. I know no one wants to hear those boring things...
You shake your head. Although you've already read about them in Eureka's file, hearing these stories from her personally still makes your heart ache.
It's not your fault, Eureka. You just didn't meet anyone who could understand and appreciate you at that time.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Yeah. Jessie said the same thing... But to meet someone like that is as hard as making a pair of shoes that can walk to the moon.
What was Jessie like?
The corners of Eureka's lips curl up ever so slightly at the mention of that name, yet the faint smile quickly fades into her memories.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: She was my best friend. Jessie... she praised my inventions as masterpieces. She said that while others might lead ordinary lives, I was different. I was born to create.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Jessie was different from me. She was bright and cheerful and passionate about inventions. Everyone liked her and her grades were good... To me, she was exceptional. I knew we were from different worlds.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: But it's strange... unlike the others, she didn't treat me like air. She took the initiative to talk to me.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: I still remember the first time we talked. She saw the automatic ink filler I made for my pen. She said...

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Eureka! You're a genius!

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Ah! I'm sorry, did I scare you? My name is Jessie. I'm a mechanical engineering student. May I admire your work?

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: It's amazing, Eureka! This is a masterpiece! You're the most talented inventor I've ever met!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: No one has ever praised me like that before. Her words... were like fuel to my engine.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: I got 56 and 32 for my main courses, and I don't have enough elective credits. I also racked up 73 absences, and haven't even been approved to take my finals... What should I do? I definitely won't graduate at this rate...

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: I got yelled at again when I went home last time. My dad even hit me... If he sees these grades, he'll probably kill me. My mom will just cry and scream at me...

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: I can't face them, and I don't know what to do in the future... How awful life is...

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Even a piece of broken glass thrown in the trash can be used to make a vase, but what about me... I might as well go be a capybara...
Eureka stands on the empty rooftop of her school building, staring blankly at the noisy field below. Complex emotions begin to well up in her.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Eureka, are you daydreaming again? Are you crying?

Eureka looks up in surprise. Seeing who it is through her tear-blurred eyes, she throws herself into Jessie's arms and starts sobbing. The heavy burden on her chest seems to be relieved by her friend's kindness and understanding.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: ...I get it. Not being able to graduate is indeed a problem.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: But Eureka, have you ever thought that maybe graduating isn't the only way out?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: ...What do you mean...?

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: My uncle has an innovative factory on the outskirts of Eastside. If you want, we can go work there together.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: We don't need a diploma from you for you to join us, Eureka. If you can't get it, then just forget about it! You're extremely talented! So what if you chose the wrong major and failed your courses?

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Don't let mundane matters constrain you. You were born to create!
Jessie's words ring out strong and clear, clearing the fog in Eureka's eyes like wind. They warm her up and make her relax again.

steps.speaker: Uncle
steps.content: Let's welcome the great inventor, Miss Eureka, to our team!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Hello, I'm Jessie's frie...

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Enough with the chit-chat, Eureka. What do you think of this work uniform? I prepared it especially for you. Try it on!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Thank you, Jessie... But, this color, I don't think it looks very good on me... Uh, I mean, sorry, I actually really like it...!
The sudden shift in her words soothes Jessie's furrowed brow. She gives Eureka a hearty pat on the shoulder.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: I knew you would like it. The moment I saw this outfit, I knew it was perfect for you, just like this place!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Yeah... yeah...

Eureka looks around at Jessie's uncle and the workers, who are all beaming at her. They overwhelm her with their thunderous applause. It's something Eureka had never experienced before, and she can't help but say to herself:

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: ...Yes, I think I belong here.

steps.speaker: Uncle
steps.content: Eureka, good news! Those electronic devices you submitted are excellent. We've discussed with the merchant and decided to put them all into production. This is a big order!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Really?! That's great! This is the first time someone has ever said I did a good job...
Eureka flashes a shy smile, rubbing her oil-stained hands vigorously on her leather apron.

steps.speaker: Uncle
steps.content: The factory needs more of your ideas. Your thoughts are the incubators for the future, Eureka. You truly are a genius!
Genius, future, well done... words she had never heard from others before were now being used to describe her. Eureka realizes she's shaking with excitement.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: I'm working on a new invention. It's a mini propulsion engine made by simplifying the inside of a car engine and adding spring crossbow parts... The advantage of this device is that it can generate a huge thrust in an instant when handheld. As for how strong the force is, I still need to test it out...

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Maybe I can apply it to the legs. But if it's for people who have difficulty walking, I should add a speed adjuster... Yes, that's right, the speed adjuster needs to be at a reasonable height, so you don't have to bend down to operate it...

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Maybe it also needs a small temperature control system... Ah, I'm sorry, I was talking to myself again!

steps.speaker: Uncle
steps.content: Great! Go ahead and do whatever you want, Eureka. I hope to see the final version soon!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Yes, okay, no problem! Thank you so much!
As she watches the middle-aged man leave, Eureka clenches her wrench excitedly, unable to calm down her pounding heart.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Eureka, how many times do I have to tell you, you have to go to Uncle's place today!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: I can't, Jessie. If they find out that I've awakened my power, they'll surely kick me out! I can't leave the factory. That's the only place I have any value. Please...

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: What nonsense are you talking about? Value? Your power is your greatest value now! Come on, follow me! Uncle is getting impatient!

The unfamiliar underground corridor is humid and stuffy. Mold spots grow in the corners, and the broken light bulb flickers nonstop. Jessie has a steely grip on Eureka's arm, and is practically dragging her along.
Eureka's pleading voice echoes in the cold corridor, but there's no response.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Here we are. Go inside.
Eureka is pushed into the brightly lit room at the end of the corridor. She instinctively closes her eyes, then opens them, and sees a sight that makes her blood run cold...

An emaciated man is tied to a post with a dirty sack over his head that muffles his sobs and moans. The shirtless man's body is covered in scars, and it's obvious that these wounds were not caused by a single tool.

steps.speaker: Uncle
steps.content: Eureka, Jessie says you're becoming more and more disobedient lately. You took so long to come here after I invited you.
He has a modified gun tightly bound to his arm. The speed adjuster at the end of it is making a steady beeping sound that makes Eureka dizzy.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: That's... That's my...

steps.speaker: Uncle
steps.content: Your what? Body speed thruster... or adjuster, or whatever it's called... The name doesn't matter. What matters is that it's a great invention, right?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: No, it can't be attached to your arm. If the speed adjustment goes wrong, the recoil of the gun becomes a huge safety hazard. You can't... please take it off. Please, I'm really scared... please don't...

steps.speaker: Uncle
steps.content: Eureka. Do you think that just because you made these prototypes, you're so great that you can defy me?
Jessie's uncle slowly walks up to the bound man, raises his arm, and points the gun at his forehead...
Bang!
The man, who was begging for mercy just a second ago, silently drops his head.
Tick-tock, tick-tock...

steps.speaker: Lab Staff
steps.content: Boss, the data is out. 85% of the recoil from firing has been offset by our modified injector. This is not far off from the order requirements. A couple more adjustments should meet the target.

steps.speaker: Uncle
steps.content: Good job. Go clean this place up.

The employee bows and backs away. Eureka stands frozen in shock as dark red liquid pools around her feet. She stares at the limp, lifeless body still hanging from the pillar, and suddenly feels that none of this is real.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: He... he's dead...?

steps.speaker: Uncle
steps.content: Yes. He violated the factory's rules. After seeing the secrets here, he refused to join us, but planned to escape instead. That's treacherous behavior, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Uncle
steps.content: Eureka, this factory is my blood, sweat, and tears. If you were in my shoes, you wouldn't want your hard work to go down the drain because of others' misunderstanding, right?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: No, that's not it... My mini propulsion engine is an assistive device, meant to be attached to legs. Its speed adjuster is designed for those with leg mobility issues...
Eureka shakes her head vigorously, desperately and mechanically repeating the original intent of her invention in a hoarse voice.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Enough! Eureka, when will you sober up?

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Don't you get it? The moment your little contraptions get turned into weapons is when they truly gain value. Now, they can truly be called "inventions."
Jessie, who had been silent all this while, suddenly speaks up. She stands behind Eureka, her voice as cold as a venomous snake. Eureka feels like she doesn't know her at all.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Jessie...? Did you... know about this all along...?

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Of course. Why else do you think I had you join my uncle's factory? Out of kindness? Afraid you'd drop out and end up on the streets?

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Don't flatter yourself. I can't stand your pitiful look, Eureka.
Jessie spits out the last word coldly and turns around without looking back, disappearing into the darkness behind the door.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: What do you mean... Jessie... We were supposed to be best friends...

Eureka hears the sticky noise of the floor being scrubbed behind her and comes back to her senses. She turns to look at Jessie's uncle, who is fiddling with his beloved gun, and backs away while saying in a hollow voice:

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: The rice cooker is still on musical mode back home... I need to go back to deal with it...

steps.speaker: Uncle
steps.content: Don't talk nonsense, Eureka. Jessie already told me. Your power can give these weapons even more strength. You must stay here. Make the most powerful weapon in the world for me! Bring me a huge order with countless money and checks!
Seeing Eureka's intent to flee, a few security guards rush up to twist her arm, halting her in her tracks.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: No...
Eureka struggles desperately, feeling intense pain in her arm. All that remains in her ears are the shrill and gruesome cackles of Jessie's uncle.

steps.speaker: Uncle
steps.content: Lock her in the laboratory we prepared. She's not allowed to come out without my permission.

steps.speaker: Uncle
steps.content: An inventor or a test subject. Eureka, which one do you choose to be?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: I won't stay here anymore!!!
The desire to resist and flee has never been stronger. Eureka yells out loud, fully unleashing her power for the first time. Several partially modified bombs on the workbench explode in response.
Boom—
The dazzling white light produced by the violent explosion instantly engulfs the entire laboratory.
After hearing Eureka's story, your heart is heavy and silent. You didn't expect an eccentric oddball like her to have also endured so much pain and misfortune.
I didn't expect this... I didn't know they forced you like that... I'm so sorry...
Eureka shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: After leaving that place, I've been on the run. I kept myself busy by constantly looking for new inspiration and making new inventions to avoid thinking about the past... But it seems that I've come full circle and ended up back here...
Heh. Even today, you're still dreaming. You still think you're the victim.
The machine nearby suddenly starts up, and the light bulb on the ceiling begins to flicker. In the darkness, a woman's figure slowly appears.
Her venomous gaze is fixated on Eureka. She lets out a sneer.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Long time no see, Eureka.
